title: Feral (bear) druid: holds one mob on itself against a DPS player

rules.desc: At most 30 percent of the mob damage events (hits counted, not amounts) land on the healer or the DPS player; the rest on the bear
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/TankFeralDruidStrategy.cpp:55-75 (growl rows at ACTION_MOVE, faerie fire, savage bite, maul); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:312-349 (LoseAggroTrigger); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: one mob, but both growl rows sit at ACTION_MOVE while the player's DPS kit adds real threat; whether the maul and swipe rotation holds it is the question. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
